title: Hostile Awareness
description: Minecraft Hostile Detector To Prevent Deaths From Hostile Mob
body:
**🧠 Hostile Awareness System**

A lightweight Fabric Minecraft mod that provides real-time hostile mob awareness through a simple HUD system.

It helps players detect nearby threats using crosshair priority, distance-based alerts, and directional indicators, while keeping gameplay balanced and vanilla-friendly.

**⚔️ Features**

Crosshair priority targeting for immediate threat focus
Nearby hostile mob detection
Distance-based warning levels (Alert / Danger / Critical)
Direction indicator (Front, Back, Left, Right)
Lightweight performance-friendly scanning system.

🎮 Designed For
Survival gameplay
Cave exploration
Hardcore worlds
Low visibility environments.

**⚙️ Info**
Fabric mod for Minecraft Java Edition. Built to enhance awareness without breaking vanilla survival mechanics.
